name: Kienstock
source: eHYD, Hydrographischer Dienst Österreich (BML); station operator via donau
datum: cm above gauge zero (194.00 m above Adriatic (m ü.A.) from 01.01.1974)

notes: Daily mean water level (W-Tagesmittel) from the eHYD yearbook export, period 01.01.1976 00:00,01.01.2024 00:00. eHYD publishes only checked yearbook (Hydrographisches Jahrbuch) data, so the series ends with the last published yearbook year.
eHYD gives no per-value quality flag; every value is marked measured.
Gap markers ('Lücke') skipped: 1. Fill values dropped: 0.

Station master data list these level methods (start, end, method): 01.01.1974 to now: Pegellatte-händische Messung; 01.01.1976 to 01.01.1997: Schwimmer (analog)-Schreibstreifen manuell; 01.01.1997 to now: Schwimmer (analog)-digitalisiert; 13.03.2002 to now: Drucksonde (direkt)-Datensammler; 29.01.2009 to now: Drucksonde (direkt)-Fernübertragung (DFÜ); 17.07.2008 to now: Pneumatic (direkt)-Datensammler; 17.07.2008 to now: Pneumatic (direkt)-Fernübertragung (DFÜ).

Footnotes on discharge and water temperature say that in some months they were computed from supplemented (filled) water levels, for example: 1996: Im Okt,Nov,Dez nach ergänzten Wasserständen ermittelt; 1996: Im Jän,Feb,Mrz,Apr,Mai,Jul,Sep,Okt nach ergänzten Wasserständen ermittelt; 1997: Im Jun,Aug,Okt nach ergänzten Wasserständen ermittelt; 1998: Im Jul,Aug,Sep,Okt nach ergänzten Wasserständen ermittelt; 1999: Im Aug,Okt,Dez nach ergänzten Wasserständen ermittelt; 2000: Im Jän,Nov,Dez nach ergänzten Wasserständen ermittelt (32 such footnotes in all). The level series itself carries no flag for these days, so they stay marked measured.
Footnotes on the level series: 01.01.2018: JB 2018: Neuberechnung des Flusskilometers.
Coordinates from the eHYD PegelAktuell map layer (WGS84).

measurement_history.fact: Gauge zero set at 194.00 m above the Adriatic datum; no later change is listed.
Altenwoerth hydropower plant, downstream of Kienstock, commissioned; Melk plant upstream followed in 1982. Their effect on the Kienstock level was not found.
Float recorder with a paper chart, read by hand, until 1997; the daily record starts here.
Pressure sensor with data logger added; remote transmission from 2009-01-29.
Station coordinates updated, a shift of about 115 m on the national grid.
Footnotes say discharge in many months of 1996 to 2016 was computed from filled-in water levels, and in 2023 from filled-in data; the level series has no per-day flag for these.
The record ends with the last published hydrological yearbook; eHYD holds history only up to the current yearbook.

public_notes: This record ends in December 2023 because Austria publishes checked data only in its yearly hydrological yearbook, which runs a few years behind. The level is measured against a fixed mark, not the riverbed.
